headline: Judiciary Faces Controversy Over School Curriculum Decision
content: There has been significant controversy following the judiciary decision regarding school curriculum aimed at eliminating gender ideology teachings. headline: Robbery Incident Leaves Store Owner Scared After Fake Police Assault
content: Disguised as police officers, armed robbers entered a textile store in Gamarra during evening hours, threatening employees before stealing approximately 50 thousand soles. headline: Iran Terror Attack Results in Multiple Casualties Including Policemen
